title: Exact realization of finite-coefficient point pullback and evaluation
statement:
Fix a prime $p$, an integer $a\geq1$, $q=p^a$, the field $k_0=\mathbf F_q$, and its fixed algebraic closure $k$, the datum of [def-weil-finite-field-fiber]. Fix a prime $\ell\ne p$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ inside the chosen algebraic closure of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, its valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$, a uniformizer $\varpi_E$, and $n\geq1$. Put $A=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$, and $h=\operatorname{Spec}(\gamma):s\to s$, where $\gamma=(z\mapsto z^q)^{-1}$ is geometric Frobenius [def-weil-frobenius-detailed]. On the small pro-etale site of $s$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] use the constant ring sheaf $A_s$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], the category $D^b_c(s,A)$ [def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility], and the point fiber functor $V=\operatorname{Fib}_s$ [def-weil-finite-coefficient-point].

Let $\mathcal M$ be the abelian category of $A_s$-module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], $\mathcal D=D(\mathcal M)$, and $\mathsf L:\mathrm{CoCh}(\mathcal M)\to\mathcal D$ its localization at quasi-isomorphisms [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Write $H_r=(h^r)^*$ for ordinary module pullback [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image, def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product] with its canonical coefficient map [prop-weil-pbc-proetale-constant-ring-map], $Q_r=L(h^r)^*$ for derived pullback [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], $\Gamma=\Gamma(s,-):\mathcal M\to A\text{-}\mathrm{Mod}$ for final-object evaluation using constant scalars, with derived evaluation $V_{\mathrm{amb}}:\mathcal D\to D(A)$ induced by it [lem-weil-point-proetale-sections-exact], $C(F)$ for termwise application of a functor $F$, and $\mathsf L_A$ for localization of complexes of $A$-modules.

For every $r\geq1$, $H_r$ and $\Gamma$ are exact additive functors, and $C(H_r)$ and $C(\Gamma)$ preserve quasi-isomorphisms. The canonical exact-functor factorizations identify the specified total derived pullback $Q_r$ and derived evaluation $V_{\mathrm{amb}}$ by natural isomorphisms
$$e_{r,K}:Q_r\mathsf L K\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathsf L C(H_r)K,\qquad v_K:V_{\mathrm{amb}}\mathsf L K\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathsf L_A C(\Gamma)K$$
for every unbounded complex $K$, with no K-flatness hypothesis on $K$. These comparisons are the exact-functor comparisons to the specified total derived functors, including on K-flat representatives. Each $Q_r$ preserves $D^b_c(s,A)$. The restriction of $V_{\mathrm{amb}}$ to $D^b_c(s,A)$, with target viewed inside $D(A)$, is the functor $V=\operatorname{Fib}_s$ and has values in $D^b_{\mathrm{fin}}(A)$ [def-weil-point-finite-cohomology-complexes].

proof.text: Use [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension] at exponent n+1 to install Finite for the coefficient ring. The canonical intrinsic pullback of [def-sp-finite-intrinsic-pullback] has additive, finite-limit and finite-colimit preservation instances, obtained by transporting exact fixed-scalar inverse image through the published coefficient realization equivalences. The point sections of [def-weil-point-section-scalar-functors] are additive; [def-weil-finite-coefficient-point] supplies their finite-limit and finite-colimit preservation instances; its pointFibreFinite_exact already proves exactness after restriction through constant sections. These are exactly the two ordinary functors in the statement, so no comparison to the alternate finite-coefficient pullback presentation is needed.

proof.text: For any quasi-isomorphism f of unbounded cochain complexes, register its QuasiIso instance. Apply HomologicalComplex.quasiIso_map_of_preservesHomology, via instance inference for each exact additive functor, as recorded in [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-factorization]. This proves both quasi-isomorphism clauses without boundedness or K-flatness assumptions. The two displayed comparison definitions are precisely mapDerivedCategoryFactors.

proof.text: Apply exactFunctor_derivedFunctor of [lem-weil-pbc-exact-functor-derived-functor] to ordinary pullback, its specified finiteDerivedPullback and trfPointPullbackExactComparison, taking the left-derived clause. This applies definitionally because [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom] defines finiteDerivedPullback as the induced exact intrinsic pullback. Apply the same theorem to pointFiniteSections and trfPointEvaluationExactComparison, taking the right-derived clause. These comparisons apply on all complexes, including K-flat representatives.

proof.text: For every point x of Spec k, frobeniusPointPrimeResidueUnit of [def-weil-frobenius-point-transport] supplies IsUnit of l in its residue field from l != p; use IsUnit.invertible to install the residue-field invertibility instances. The hom of the rth power of the point automorphism is an isomorphism. Apply isomorphismFiniteDerivedPullback_termwise of [lem-weil-isomorphism-derived-pullback] and take the first component of its membership conclusion. This gives bounded constructibility for the specified finite derived pullback.

proof.text: Unfold the full-subcategory lift in pointFiniteFibre of [def-weil-finite-coefficient-point]. Composing it with the full inclusion is definitionally the restriction of the displayed ambient derived evaluation, so the final equality is rfl. Its codomain is already the subcategory of bounded finite cohomology; no second application of point-sections finiteness is required.
